Это согласованная пара фиксированного ha: This is a matched pair of the fixed handshake of our test bench. It does not replace a Steam password and is not a universal key of the ROE servers. Клиент, игровые бинарники, архивы ресурс: The client, game binaries, resource archives, real account keys/tickets and full network captures are not included. The fixed local handshake data of 16/32 bytes is distributed only in ring-of-elysium-local at the owner's direct instruction. The game names belong to their rights holders; the project is unofficial. The public adaptation of LobbyPreData.cs removes the embedded CK and reads a local file.
